verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted engine you install with pip/uv or build from source, and it runs on your own hardware. Its docs explicitly reference offline inference and a locally started OpenAI-compatible server, and list support for CPUs, GPUs and Apple Silicon. Quantization lets large models fit on more modest devices. missing for 10: explicit documentation that no data or telemetry leaves the device, fully air-gapped/offline model loading guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of running on a personal machine.
